last_etwap_base_supply_at_init.meaning: lastETWAPBaseSupply value seeded during market init

first_mint_crosses_no_cap_limit.meaning: a first minter performs a mint that crosses the noCapLimit threshold, adding just over one token

etwap_recovery_half_life_minutes.checkpoint: after the over-threshold mint, during recovery

etwap_growth_percent_after_manual_update.meaning: ETWAP growth of 50% reached only after ~30 minutes even with a manual updateState call
etwap_growth_percent_after_manual_update.checkpoint: after the over-threshold mint, during recovery

market_frozen_interim.meaning: market remains effectively frozen in the interim while ETWAP recovers
market_frozen_interim.checkpoint: after the over-threshold mint, during recovery

assumptions: The first over-threshold minter is treated as an ordinary user performing a permissionless mint; no authorization is required by the report.
The checked follow-up mint is a valid deposit that should not be blocked by a stale near-zero TWAP.
ETWAP recovery timing is measured from the over-threshold mint.

unresolved.description: Report does not specify the exact noCapLimit threshold value or the precise amount added beyond one token.
The 'roughly an hour' freeze duration is approximate and depends on ETWAP decay timing not fully specified.

limitations: The 30-minute half-life and 50% growth figures are approximate as stated in the report.
The relation encodes the reported recovery timing and interim freeze, not a concrete numeric TWAP model.
Whether the first over-threshold minter is an attacker or ordinary user is not resolved by the report.
